about.title2: on your side of the mic.
about.p1: I’m Clareny, music producer and mix engineer. I have worked with artists, producers, composers and writers, and I have also lived music as a singer.
about.p2: That experience lets me empathize with what you want to say and help you make your ideas real. I produce looking for your color, the connection and the cut that sticks.
about.p3: As a mix engineer, the search is the same: that your identity is what gets heard.
about.mentorWa: Hi Clareny, I want to book a mentoring session.
